related.title: NVIDIA GB200 NVL72 機架系統
related.why: 可遷移節點、互連、I/O及復原的分層分析；拓撲、資源配置與工作流不同。
related.whyEn: Layered node, fabric, I/O and recovery analysis transfers, with different topology, resources and workflows.
related.transfer: 可遷移節點、互連、I/O及復原的分層分析；拓撲、資源配置與工作流不同。
related.transferEn: Layered node, fabric, I/O and recovery analysis transfers, with different topology, resources and workflows.
related.difference: 本課針對雙 CPU、NVSwitch 與計算／儲存網路分層；NVIDIA GB200 NVL72 機架系統改以Grace–Blackwell、機架 NVLink 與液冷為架構重點，不能直接沿用幾何、邊界或產品數值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on dual cpus, nvswitch and compute/storage fabric layers; NVIDIA GB200 NVL72 rack system centers on grace-blackwell, rack nvlink and liquid cooling, so geometry, boundaries and product values cannot transfer unchanged.
practice: 對照H100與主記憶拓撲與Grace與Blackwell記憶，重畫兩項工程的輸入及系統邊界。
把本課假想算例移到NVIDIA GB200 NVL72 機架系統，列出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以BMC與作業復原為起點，設計一項能區分「雙 CPU、NVSwitch 與計算／儲存網路分層」與「Grace–Blackwell、機架 NVLink 與液冷」的觀測，註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare h100 and host-memory topology with grace/blackwell memory and redraw inputs and boundaries.
Transfer the assumed example to NVIDIA GB200 NVL72 rack system, separating reusable equations from respecified parameters.

Start from bmc and job recovery and propose an observation distinguishing dual cpus, nvswitch and compute/storage fabric layers from grace-blackwell, rack nvlink and liquid cooling, including uncertainty.
